prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist, and availability/insurance matter a lot for a routine checkup and cleaning. I also can’t verify today’s reviews or appointment openings in real time.

For Pleasanton, I’d choose a practice that has:

- A current California dental license and strong recent patient feedback specifically mentioning cleanings, hygiene staff, and conservative treatment plans  
- Your insurance in network—or clear self-pay pricing  
- A comprehensive new-patient exam: cleaning, periodontal measurements, dentist exam, and X-rays only when appropriate  
- Convenient recall appointments and good availability for cleanings  

Good places to check are the ADA’s dentist finder, your dental-insurance directory, and Google/Yelp reviews filtered to the most recent year. When calling, ask: “What is the total new-patient cost for an exam, cleaning, and necessary X-rays, and is the cleaning included if I have gum disease?”

If you tell me your insurance plan, whether you prefer a woman/man dentist, your part of Pleasanton, and whether you need evening/weekend appointments, I can help you narrow down what to look for.
